title: Personal AI teaching workspace
summary: Adds eight teaching modes, validated interactive lessons and tests, saved sessions and concept practice memory, supported browser attachments and speech, and secure usage-limited structured generation.

changes.detail: Eight pedagogical modes, schema-validated roadmaps/lessons/quizzes/evaluations/revisions/challenges, lesson resume, timed tests, concept evidence and memory controls.
Browser image/PDF/TXT attachment input and capability-detected dictation/playback; native fallback is explicit. Interactive process, timeline, linear-function and triangle diagrams.
Existing teacher links to workspace; plan lesson passes exact plan/step context. Progress migration, export and backup include tutor state.
Authenticated structured provider route, validation, rate limits, daily conservative token reservations and usage telemetry without learner content.
